$comment: SHA-256 of lowercased words that must never appear in a published skill or its manifests — internal project names, codenames, customers. Stored hashed, never in plaintext: a denylist that spelled these out would publish in the repo exactly what it exists to keep out of the repo. Add a term with `node scripts/build-skills.mjs deny <term>` (it is hashed on the way in and never written, echoed, or logged). Matching is per whole word, case-insensitive, minimum three characters. Failures report file and line only — never the term, because CI logs are as public as this file would have been.
